title: An Encounter
overview: At a party, reserved college student Kakeru meets a mysterious and charming young woman who is unable to see.

title: Fuyutsuki Koharu
overview: Kakeru takes Koyuki to try out an old piano and the two tour a Meiji era sailboat that is preserved on campus.

title: The Yellow Bookmark
overview: Kakeru and Koharu go to karaoke with friends and decide to check out the university's fireworks club together.

title: First Date
overview: Kakeru and Koharu go on their fireworks shopping trip and then enjoy a very relaxing ride home on a water bus.

title: Aerial Fireworks
overview: Kakeru and his roommate Narumi get a chance to take Koharu and Yuko for a ride on the college's cutter boat.

title: The Empty Terrace Seat
overview: Kakeru shares an intimate moment with Koharu and then turns to Narumi and Hayase for advice on how to proceed.

title: Transparent
overview: After Koharu disappears for a week, Kakeru and Yuko get a clue about where she is and run out to look for her.

title: Pangs of Love
overview: Hoping to spend time with Koharu, Kakeru and friends decide to volunteer at the hospital where she is staying.

title: Alone
overview: Still volunteering at the hospital, Kakeru learns more about Koharu's illness and happens to meet her mother.
